revealed_pattern: Greedy + sorting by eligibility threshold + max heap (priority queue) + monotonic forward pointer

recognition_signals: Repeatedly choose the maximum/minimum among currently eligible candidates.

Brute force repeatedly rescans all candidates at every step.
